msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia tangara-jewelry-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a gold necklace with a crescent moon and small coloured clover charms, with matching earrings, in an open blush pink jewellery box, no logos from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia tangara-jewelry-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a gold-plated cross pendant on a fine chain, set with small crystals from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia tangara-jewelry-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of gold chain necklaces with colourful enamel charms of hearts, flowers and shells from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
